Tuple Command-Line Interface v2026_08_20.0

  tuple login               | Start the login process.
  tuple auth AUTH_CODE      | Finish the login process.
  tuple logout

  tuple call                | Call someone.
  tuple join CALL_URL       | Join the given call via URL.
  tuple new                 | Starts and joins a new call with your personal URL.
  tuple end                 | End and/or leave the current call.

  tuple ls                  | List contacts.
  tuple favorite USER_ID    | Favorite a contact (or use "unfavorite").

  tuple share/unshare       | Share/Unshare your screen.
  tuple mute/unmute         | Mute/Unmute your microphone.

  tuple on                  | Ensure the daemon is running to accept incoming calls.
  tuple off                 | Stop the daemon.
  tuple ui                  | Show experimental debugging UI.

  tuple settings            | List all settings/values
  tuple set NAME VALUE      | Update a setting with the given value
